technology_name: Nanocomposite Membrane for High-Efficiency Wastewater Filtration and Desalination
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional forward osmosis filtration systems struggle with low water flux rates, high reverse salt leakage, and severe internal membrane bio-fouling from organic waste.
description: A high-performance forward osmosis thin-film composite membrane structurally reinforced by incorporating pristine, triazine-structured Covalent Organic Framework (COF) nanostructures directly into the selective polyamide separation layer.
applications: Industrial wastewater reclamation, desalination plants, power generation cooling loops, and specialized recovery of high-value compounds from aqueous processing streams.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
